about: Verdicts of the real judge on the synthetic candidates of docs/v3/spikes/judge/candidates.json, recorded with prompt version 4 (docs/v3/SPIKE-JUDGE.md, B-173): the judge quotes the candidate's sentences and never writes the memory. Each entry is the verdict of one recorded call: v4-b25b (c06 to c30) where the candidate was in it, else v4-b25a (c01 to c25). Replayed by the daemon tests; every text is synthetic.
